text:
Sam: Quick heads-up — found a minor schema mismatch in staging causing intermittent 502s for embeddings (~0.5% requests). Patch PR #987 ready. Late change window in ~18m. Requesting expedited rollforward to prod.
Deploybot: release artifact built: redwood/inference:pr-987. Staging smoke passed. Proposed plan: staging -> canary 5% for 10m -> prod. Canary config: rollback if error_rate > 1% or p95 latency > 1.5x baseline. To promote:
```bash
deploy promote --from staging --to canary --image redwood/inference:pr-987
```
Decision: allow skip-canary? ops approval required for skip.
Olivia: What's the rollback playbook and how do we pin back to previous image quickly?
Ben: If we skip canary we need 2 eng approvals + ops watch. I'm leaning toward running canary unless ops says monitoring is green.
Maria: +1 for canary by default. If ops promises immediate rollback button and logs are instrumented, I can agree to skip.
Ops-oncall: I'm awake and can monitor. I'll set short-term alerts and prepare the quick-rollback job: `deploy rollback --to-image redwood/inference:stable`. I can flip traffic or cut prod image within 90s.
Sam: OK — need explicit approvals. Maria and Olivia please react with :thumbsup: to skip canary, otherwise we run the 5% canary.
Ben: +1 (thumbsup). ops-oncall: can you confirm you'll trigger rollback on the threshold?
Ops-oncall: Confirmed. I'll trigger and announce rollback in #incidents if I cut traffic. Setting alerts now.
Olivia: I'm +1 to skip canary given ops confirmation and the rollback command.
Maria: +1. Release notes and user-facing change are tiny (schema mapping fix). Notes: https://internal.redwood/release/987
Deploybot: Consensus reached: skip_canary=true. Initiating promote to prod in 2m. Running pre-checks...
Deploybot: PRECHECK OK — migrating traffic in 3 phases. Will post update at each phase.
Ops-oncall: Dashboards and synthetic probes targeting embeddings endpoint are green pre-roll. Watching for error spikes.
Deploybot: Phase 1 -> 20% traffic to pr-987. No regressions observed after 60s.
Deploybot: Phase 2 -> 60% traffic. Monitoring p50/p95 and error rates. No alerts so far.
Deploybot: Phase 3 -> 100% traffic promoted. Rollout complete. No rollback triggered.
Sam: Thanks everyone — will follow up with short release note in #release-notes and tag impacted customers.
Maria: Nice. Filing a short postmortem if any regressions surface.
Ben: Good job.
Olivia: Thx all.
